title: The two acceptance paths: Level 1 and 2 versus Level 3
caption: Mastercard describes a no-code path, where an edge provider checks agent signatures and agents type tokens into existing forms, and a deeper path with consumer identity objects and the Intent API. Level 3 intent exchange is labeled future facing.
alt: Flowchart. A merchant chooses a path. The no-code path, Levels 1 and 2: Web Bot Auth verification at the CDN, agentic token or virtual card token with DTVC typed into existing card forms, optional Agent User Identity and Payment Data objects in the request body at Level 2. The deeper path, Level 3: merchant agentic API, Intent API with intentId, tokenized credentials with DSRP cryptogram, merchant validates intent. Both end in a normal card authorization.

sourceOfTruth.label: Mastercard Developers Level 1 to 3 agentic commerce guides
